text_block_list.text:
The Symboli family has deep ties to the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. Satake Mei 
holds firmly in her heart the words of
the Umamusume who once challenged that 
magnificent stage.

"To build a bridge to the world"— To 
become a bridge for Umamusume chasing 
their dreams, she reaffirmed her 
determination.

Meanwhile, with the Representative 
Exchange Races over, the members of 
Project L'Arc poured even greater effort 
into their training.

Pushing each other toward the same goal 
helps both sides reach even greater 
heights.

And there's one more thing... We have our 
own goal here. And that is—
choice_data_list: I want to be recognized by Mei Satake

text_block_list.text:
When Mei Satake acknowledges that I can 
become stronger than anyone...
surely that 
will be the day I can claim the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.text:
When I can surpass Sirius Symboli, who 
shows more obsession with the world stage 
than anyone...
surely that will be the day 
I can claim the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

When I am acknowledged by El Condor Pasa, 
whose fighting spirit blazes with eyes
set firmly on the world...
surely that will be 
the day I can claim the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

When I can catch up to Manhattan Cafe,
who 
seeks to challenge the world more calmly 
than anyone...
surely that will be the day 
I can claim the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

When I can surpass Nakayama Festa, who 
strives and desires victory more
earnestly than anyone...
surely that will be the day 
I can claim the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

When I gain the sheer guts of Gold Ship, 
who is more unconventional than anyone
and easily blows past all imagination... 
surely that will be the day I can claim 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

Satono Diamond has an unyielding spirit 
toward victory stronger than anyone... 
That is precisely why we cannot afford to 
lose to her either.

When I can surpass Tap Dance City, who 
captivates everyone with steps more 
brilliant than any other... That will 
surely be the day I can win the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

If one aims for the world's throne, they 
must obtain a power greater even than
that 
of Orfevre, who possesses both the 
strength and tyranny befitting a king.

Loving "humans" and aiming for the "Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe" for the sake of 
"humans"—that is Blast Onepiece.
A resolve 
surpassing her feelings is essential to 
victory.

The day she surpasses Chrono Genesis,
with 
her vast racing knowledge and unerring 
analytical prowess... that will surely be 
the day she can conquer the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe.

Beneath his gentle demeanor,
Victoire Pisa 
holds firmly to his dream of taking on
the 
world. If they can surpass him—their own 
dreams will surely connect to the world
as well.

When I can surpass Kiseki—who constantly 
chases frenzy and creates dramatic 
developments straight out of a manga—
that 
is surely the day I'll be ready to win
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
